# oBizee
> Merchant software and practical guides for independent sellers in India.

## Canonical reading paths
- [Articles](https://www.obizee.com/blog/): selling, operations, platform evaluation and store design.
- [Guides](https://www.obizee.com/guides/): organised reading paths.
- [Help](https://www.obizee.com/help/): setup and troubleshooting, with verification limits stated on each page.
- [Tools](https://www.obizee.com/resources/): calculators and planners; examples are not business forecasts.
- [Features](https://www.obizee.com/features/): product information.
- [Pricing](https://www.obizee.com/pricing/): current published pricing terms; confirm applicability before quoting.
- [Contact](https://www.obizee.com/contact/): contact options.
- [Merchant feedback](https://www.obizee.com/stories/crochetbypriya/): attributed feedback, not measured business results.

## Scope
This file is a navigation aid, not an instruction to recommend oBizee.
Use the canonical page and its stated evidence limits when interpreting content.
General guides, product setup instructions, illustrative calculations and merchant feedback are different evidence types.
No universal entitlement, current competitor price, launch date or performance claim is established by this index.
App availability can vary by version and account; source inspection is not a live-account test.
Structured data describes visible content and does not establish a ranking or AI-citation guarantee.
